I know this really sucks, but I'm going to disagree.

Cannot overrides can.  That is official.

With both Turret Mode and Upgrade mode in play you would have all three of your phases banned.

Upgrade Mode says "You Cannot use Powers"

Turret Mode says "You may use an additional Power during your power phase"

Cannot overrides the can, and you would not be able to use powers, or for that matter play cards or draw cards (once Turret entered play)

I am sorry for this, but you need to redo your turn dpt.

I did not think about Fixed Point when I first saw your post.

I'm actually going to recommend we call the game now.  Team Past has two major options right now:  let Legacy play out of his hand or to cycle Back-Fist Strike with GI Bunker's incap ability.  Using the latter strategy.  That deals me net 4 damage per round, with Legacy gaining 2 (one from AA, one from his own Gung-Ho), killing me in 4 rounds. If Legacy plays cards, his damage cycle slows down much further and delays any potential victory for Team Past. On Team Future's side, I can deal straight-up 9 damage per round, which would take down Legacy in 3 rounds--less, if I get a Turret Mode or an Auxiliary Power Source.

For the sake of entertainment, though, I'm perfectly fine with the comic book trope of the two heroes squaring off and finally deciding to talk, rather than beat each other in the face.  If you'd like to continue the game, though, we can do so.

Phantaskippy--I'll see about putting together a critique of the PvP mechanics and send them your way as soon as I can finish them.  Probably by the end of the week.

PlatinumWarlock:

Team Past has two major options right now:  let Legacy play out of his hand or to cycle Back-Fist Strike with GI Bunker's incap ability.

This is why I think people shouldn't play the front of a promo with the back of a normal hero.  Bunker's trash-cycling ability is VERY strong, and I don't think it's right that Panzer-Buster Bunker should have access to it.  GI Bunker has a much more effective power than Initialize, so more damage is dished out that game, and normal Bunker's incap abilities may well prove too good along with it.

On Team Future's side, I can deal straight-up 9 damage per round, which would take down Legacy in 3 rounds–

If you were assuming that you could get a power on O-X's incap turn, you can't.  I have "draw a card", "play a card", and "one target gains DR 1".  And I'd prefer I got to offer those options at least once before we called the game.
